title: Nhận diện khuôn mặt nơi công cộng · Advantages / Disadvantages
prompt: In some societies, using facial recognition in public spaces to prevent crime is being considered. Do the advantages of this approach outweigh the disadvantages?
instructions: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

paragraphs: Identifying a wanted suspect and recording every passer-by involve very different uses of facial recognition. I support narrowly authorised searches for serious suspects, but oppose making continuous public identification a general priority. On balance, the disadvantages are greater in the unrestricted form proposed.

Facial recognition can help investigators locate specific suspects. Matching a verified image against a narrowly defined watchlist may accelerate an otherwise lengthy search. Police could search for a person linked to a serious offence at a transport interchange. A restricted watchlist creates a more testable purpose than general surveillance, because investigators can explain whose location is sought and why identification is necessary. Locating a named suspect is a narrower purpose than continuously identifying everyone at a station, and the former does not automatically justify the latter.

Routine identification can chill lawful activity and expose innocent people to mistaken suspicion. Identification errors can expose an innocent person to investigation, while systematic recording may discourage people from attending lawful meetings or demonstrations. These costs affect people beyond the intended suspects, so investigative usefulness alone cannot establish that unrestricted use is justified. Use should require a clear legal basis, independent oversight and strict retention limits. Oversight must examine both authorisation and actual use, with deletion rules preventing a temporary investigation from becoming a permanent record of lawful public activity. Any gain in investigative speed should be weighed against false matches, interference with lawful activity and the availability of less intrusive methods. A shorter search cannot by itself compensate for monitoring large numbers of innocent people who have no realistic way to avoid public spaces.
The strongest case is for a limited investigative tool; routine identification sacrifices too much freedom for a benefit that targeted searches may already provide.

paragraphs.quote: Routine identification can chill lawful activity and expose innocent people to mistaken suspicion. Identification errors can expose an innocent person to investigation, while systematic recording may discourage people from attending lawful meetings or demonstrations. These costs affect people beyond the intended suspects, so investigative usefulness alone cannot establish that unrestricted use is justified. Use should require a clear legal basis, independent oversight and strict retention limits. Oversight must examine both authorisation and actual use, with deletion rules preventing a temporary investigation from becoming a permanent record of lawful public activity. Any gain in investigative speed should be weighed against false matches, interference with lawful activity and the availability of less intrusive methods. A shorter search cannot by itself compensate for monitoring large numbers of innocent people who have no realistic way to avoid public spaces.

Đề xuất giám sát nhưng không nêu ai kiểm tra việc sử dụng và thời hạn giữ dữ liệu.
review: Task Response: Kết luận phải trả lời bên nào nặng hơn và tại sao. Một rủi ro khắc phục được khác với một tổn thất nghiêm trọng khó đảo ngược. Đã xử lý phản biện “Routine identification can chill lawful activity and expose innocent people to mistaken suspicion.” chưa?

Coherence & Cohesion: đã giải thích cơ chế và điều kiện? Không dùng ví dụ tìm tội phạm nghiêm trọng để biện hộ nhận diện mọi người mọi lúc. Nhận nhầm có thể chuyển người vô tội thành đối tượng kiểm tra; đúng kết quả kỹ thuật chưa bảo đảm tính hợp pháp.
Lexical Resource: dùng “retention limits” đúng nghĩa “giới hạn thời gian được giữ dữ liệu”, không thay thuật ngữ chính xác bằng từ hoa mỹ?
Grammar: can/could/may thể hiện khả năng chứ không chứng minh quan hệ nhân quả; mệnh đề điều kiện có nêu đúng điều kiện trong tình huống không?
